name: cholcov
expr: [T1, p1] = cholcov(S1); [T2, p2] = cholcov(S2); [T3, p3] = cholcov(S3); [T4, p4] = cholcov(S4); err1 = max(max(abs(T1'*T1 - S1))); err2 = max(max(abs(T2'*T2 - S2))); rows1 = size(T1, 1); rows2 = size(T2, 1); rows3 = size(T3, 1);
comment: MATLAB cholcov: Cholesky-like factor of (possibly singular) covariance. Bit-equal with MATLAB R2025b on key invariants: PD case gives upper-triangular n×n (T'*T = SIGMA exactly), PSD rank-r case gives r×n (T'*T = SIGMA up to rounding), indefinite/negative gives empty T and p > 0. Eigvec sign/ordering can differ between engines so we pin invariants (residual + dimensions + p), not literal entries beyond the PD diagonal. Octave 11.1.0 doesn't ship cholcov in core (statistics package only); reports N/A.
